'''Igma Korto''' was a resident of [[Mos Taike/Legends|Mos Taike]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:LP" />

==Biography==
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Igma Korto resided in Mos Taike. One of her friends who worked for the [[Corellia Times]] was being roughed up by a local resident. Worried that he and the town would receive bad press, [[Lorne Prestar]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to "teach the thug a lesson."<ref name="SWG:LP" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Igma Korto was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
